effective_scope: All question/answer positions from every discovered 108–114 original G04 S1 Natural Science source; preserve additional discovery candidates
operator_decision: Approved explicit user directive: 不分出版社、不分考試別、不以整卷合格率限制，只要題目符合四上45個canonical KP，就全部保留並進行入庫驗收。
admitted_candidate_predicate: A question has at least one valid canonical KP in G04-S1-U01/U02/U03/U04 -> KEEP_KP_MATCH_CANDIDATE, regardless of its original exam-type/publisher/paper-level rating. Candidate ≠ approved public release.

decisions.KP_MATCH_CANDIDATE: Retain exact source slot and enter science, provenance, diagram and image-dependent acceptance pipeline.
decisions.KP_MATCH_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_HOLD: Retain the source slot and inferred KP match; missing source figure/text/answers blocks certification, never silently discard.
decisions.REVIEW_KP_UNCERTAIN: Retain unresolved original source position; do not decide based solely on subject keywords.
decisions.NONMATCH_G04S1_KP_ARCHIVE: Archive the source position with reason and optional target-other-grade/unit, not G04-S1 public bank.
decisions.PUBLISHED_EXISTING_SOURCE: Preserve source lineage and existing published entry without re-publishing duplicate slot.

duplicate_policy: Do not eliminate source positions because equivalent questions already exist; link duplicates to canonical item concept, keep all provenance, and prevent identical repetition on the same generated worksheet.
historical_overlay_policy: Do not overwrite any prior source pilot statuses including WRONG_PERIOD; create new item-level KP-first assessments referencing original annotations.
figure_policy: Pictures and graph-dependent questions remain eligible to be kept but certification waits for original diagram and exact learner-facing figure proof.
